correctness.rationale: The 16-state irreducible open exclusion generator has an analytic stationary expansion about reservoir mean 1/2. The normalized Poisson equations for p1 and p2 identify c2(a)=-2a(a-1)P(a)/((a+1)Q(a)^2); all coefficients of the displayed P and Q are strictly positive, so c2 has sign 1-a for all a>0. For chains of <=3 sites, reflection with equal clean endpoints forces the current odd in delta. Independent symbolic reciprocal-polynomial calculation reproduced P_new(a)=a^8 P_prior(1/a) and Q_new(a)=a^5 D_prior(1/a), exactly matching the predecessor current coefficient under t=1/a. This is a mathematical exact identity, not inferred from finite spot checks.
